mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a full moon over Verona Community Park with a temperature of 71 degrees and an air quality index of 55, while we look forward to an overnight low of 62 with no rain in the forecast.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest where students in grades K through 12 submitted 53 original designs. The community is invited to vote online or at City Hall for their favorite designs through August 7 to determine the stickers used in the November election.
There is plenty to do with Hop Haus Trivia and Lake Lou-ee Trivia taking place today, followed by tomorrow featuring the Farmer's Market and Yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a noteworthy call from last Monday, July 27, an officer located a driver involved in a hit and run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane.
Today's flavor of the day is delicious Turtle. Culver's of Verona is currently open, but since it is almost 11 PM, they will be closing in less than an hour, so get there soon.
